app_prerequisites.all: An installed command alone does not prove ownership, observation, input, save/export or reopened-artifact readiness. Setup opens blank windows only; inputs are opened by the solver through GUI.
app_prerequisites.browser: Real installed ordinary-profile browser with fresh authenticated X11/AT-SPI identity, native whole-observation and exact cleanup proof; no headless/CDP wrapper.
app_prerequisites.calc_and_writer: Use the existing owned LibreOffice launch guards: exact installed soffice.bin/PID/start and safe per-child environment; SAL_DISABLE_OPENCL=1 and remove SC_FORCE_CALCULATION. Reject unsafe existing-process handoff. No private profile/global setting change or anonymous OpenCL setup.
app_prerequisites.vlc: Prove real player native ownership, playlist persistence and read-only MPRIS state before executing any media case.

authority.goal_transport: one initial foreground TEXT goal; no speech/ASR/TTS

memory.required_case_rule: write source-bound paths/facts near completion; immediate fresh same-cookie text recall with memory_search only

method.cleanup: polite exact owned XID/PID/start close only; unknown ownership is failure/uncertainty, never empty-list cleanup pass
method.policy: Unique semantic actions skip Kev; record actual calibrated policy receipts for ambiguity, not configured availability as exercised coverage.
required_evidence: exact XID/PID/start plus owned transient guard
fresh raw controller before/after and dispatch receipts
actual keyboard typing receipt where text entered
actual physical mouse receipt and non-setup pointer movement
official source address and visible section acquisition through GUI
independent saved-artifact readback and reopen trace
method.solver: native actual desktop applications and ordinary browser profile only
method.vision: Record actual model/revision/frame/digest/point receipts if invoked; configured-but-unused is unexercised. Only eligible missing named targets invoke native pointing.

metrics: auxiliary model revisions and actual calls
first blocking cause and challenge exposure

proposed_budget.hour_scale_extension: separate cohort; not original benchmark equivalence

readiness_claim: All task readiness false. Specs, installed commands, CPU validation and earlier primitives are not long-task passes.

repeats.extra_repeats_require_separate_label: do not silently turn200cells into600; report all attempts/model order

scoring.partial: fixed checkpoint denominator reported separately; do not discard setup/blocked cases
scoring.strict_success: all mandatory outcome, method and preservation checks true from independent current evidence

source_freeze.before_live: Freeze exact official URLs, sections, as-of/version, primary-content hashes and independent fact rubric; these are not acquired by this draft
source_freeze.dynamic_venue_facts: score against captured date/version, not future changed hours/prices
source_freeze.evaluator: read-only primary reference verification is allowed; keep oracle/answer pack inaccessible to solver
source_freeze.solver: find/read sources via real GUI; no setup navigation or answers
